translation.name: Jamaw ta Marbinto: Kabarre ta Gala ɗo bi ka Iisa Masi iŋ daŋla

book.name: Akt
book.title: Akt Riy ta paliinna ku Iisa Masi

content: Martaw ta awalle ta Pool
Ruwwin ta Buŋdi n̰aamig Pool iŋ Barnabaas ɗo riyor
Ɗo *Egliz ka Antiyoos, gin gee kuuk garkiyaagu ho iŋ nabiinna oki : ŋuur Barnabaas, Simeyon kaak ŋu koliy oki Pondiko, Lisiyuus kaak min Sireen, Manayeen kaak maaɗ iŋ Sultan *Herood, ho iŋ Sawuul.
Ƴiriy rakki, wiktin taat ŋu ictu sayamne ho ŋu salkiyiy ɗo *Rabbiner, Ruwwin ta Buŋdi kaawiico aman : « Imilonduug Barnabaas iŋ Sawuul ɗo riy taat nu koliig a ŋuudu gine. »
Kar min ŋu ictu pey sayamne ho ŋu salkiytu, ŋu asiico laa pise ɗo kaƴco ho ŋu rasiig ŋu ɗeettu gine riy ta Buŋdi.
Barnabaas iŋ Sawuul ɗo kiɗ ka Sipre
Ar taat Ruwwin ta Buŋdi n̰aamiig Barnabaas iŋ Sawuul ɗo riyor, ŋu ɗeettu ɗo geeger ka Seluusi. Min eɗe-ak, ŋu n̰eptu markaba, ŋu ɗeettu Sipre, ɗo kiɗ kaak ɗatik amiydi.
Min ŋu ottu ɗo wer-ak, ŋu paaytu ɗo geeger ka Salaamin ho ŋu teestu gaare kaaw ta Buŋdi ɗo ger ka salaaner ka *Yuudinnar. Wiktin taar-at, Yaaya-Maark sa goy iŋ ŋuura, ŋa gaayaagu.
Kar min ŋu gaay birin̰ kiɗ okin̰ji ka Sipre, ŋu ottu ɗo geeger ka Papoos. Ɗo wer-ak, ŋu ŋaamtu iŋ gem rakki, ŋu kolaag Baar-Iisa, ŋa Yuudin̰ce. Ŋaar gay olgo ho ŋa gina ziy ar nabiin̰ce.
Ŋa goy ɗo serpey ta guberneer kaak ŋu kolaag Serziyuus Poluus. Guberneer-ak iban gamna. Ŋa koliig Barnabaas iŋ Pool ɗo geriy, asaan ŋa raka a ŋuuji gaare kaaw ta Buŋdi.
Kar olga-ak gay toɗco, asaan ŋa rakaaɗo a guberneer-ak yaa aamine ɗo Iisa Masi. (Olga-ak, ŋu kolaag iŋ kaaw ta Grek a « Elimaas ».)
Min ŋaar-ak, Ruwwin ta Buŋdi miiniit gelbiney ka Sawuul kaak ŋu kolaag oki Pool. Paa ko, Pool taliig gem-ak ƴalaaŋ ɗo odinay
ho ŋa kaawiiji aman : « Kiŋke-aŋ gem kaak raada. Ki caaciya gee ! Taloŋ ja roŋ ka seetanner-aŋka ! Ki adin ka ay maan kaak samaane. Botol ta *Rabbiner-an, illa a ki niginti ja.

Hadi diŋ cokay samaane : Rabbin Buŋ yaan̰ giɗe ho ki asiy noole, kii taaye, ki talaatɗo pato. » Min ŋaar-ak di, ŋa nooltu, wer giniiji dulum. Ŋa danduma meeda n̰ugila a ŋaa gasen di gemo yaa ɗaan̰in̰ji.
Min guberneer taliig maan kaak asji ɗo Elimaas-ak, ŋa ajbiytu tak-tak ɗo garaan taat asa min ɗo Rabbin Buŋ ho ŋa aamintu ɗo kaawoy.
Pool gaara kaaw ta Buŋdi Antiyoos ta Pisidi
Kar Pool iŋ een̰ji gay, ŋu amiltu min Papoos ho ŋu n̰eptu markaba ŋu aaltu Perz ɗo kiɗ ka Pampili. Min ŋu ottu, Yaaya-Maark rasiig kat eɗe ho ŋa yeeptu Zeruzaleem.
Min ŋaar-ak, kun̰ Pool amiltu min Perz, ŋu ictu botol taat ɓaa Antiyoos ɗo kiɗ ka Pisidi. Ƴiriy ta *sabitdi, ŋu un̰jitu ɗo ger ka salaaner ka *Yuudinnar ho ŋu goytu.

Kar gee kuuk ɗo ger ka salaaner-ak garkiytu min ɗo *gaanuun kaak Muusa siirtu ho iŋ maktumne ta nabiinnar. Ɗo wer-ak, agindaw ku ger ka salaaner-ak kaawiico ɗo kun̰ Pool aman : « Ya ku gin kaaw taat yaani bere gudurre sa kaawonninta kate. »
Hiyya, Pool uctu. Ŋa tawgitu pisin̰ji a ŋuu bugume. Kar ŋa ɗiyiico aman : « Kuŋ gee ku Israyeel ho kuŋ kuuk karmiya Buŋ, cokiyonnu !
Buŋ ka geente ku Israyeel, ŋaar ko kaak doɓig aginiyte. Ŋa wadiriigu wiktin taat ŋu goyiy ɗo kiɗ ka Meser. Kar iŋ gudurrey tan̰ji kat ŋa imiliig min eɗe.
Buŋ tal kaaco ka geen̰ji ɗo wiktin taat ŋu goyiy ɗo goosiner ar elgin orok pooɗ pa.
Min pa-ak, ŋa idiig gee ku darrinay kuuk peesira kuuk goy ɗo kiɗ ka Kana ho ŋa beriicog kiɗ-ak ɗo geen̰ji.

Min gamin-ak kuuniytu, kiɗ-aŋ goy ɗo pisin̰co ar elgin miy pooɗ iŋ orok beeƴ (450) pa. « Min ŋaar-ak, Buŋ doɓtu min aginiyte gay seriiner a ŋuuco ɗukumin kaawco kee nam ɗo wiktin taat nabi Samiyeel yaa ase.
Wiktin taat Samiyeel goyiy misa iŋ odinay, aginiyte inditu Buŋ a ŋaaco imile sultan. Ek di Samiyeel darjiyiico Sawuul roŋ ka Kiis, min tamba ta Benjamin. Ŋa goytu elgin orok pooɗ min ŋu darjiyiiga.
Min ŋaar-ak, Buŋ paayiig Sawuul min ɗo meennuwiy ho ŋa darjiyiig Dawuud kaak Buŋ kaawtu biy aman : ‟ Ŋaar Dawuud, roŋji ka Jeese kat nu eltu. Ŋaa gine ay maan kaak gelbiner rakiyo. ”
Min tamba ta Dawuud ko amiltu Iisa Masi kaak Buŋ kaawtu a ŋaa n̰aame ɗo gee ku Israyeel a ŋaa jilin̰co. Ansii ko, kaaw taat Buŋ kaawiiji ɗo Dawuud min awalle-at as kat ɗo werti.
Min Iisa bal teese misa riy ta Buŋdi, Yaaya-Batist astu kaawiico ɗo gee ku Israyeel okin̰co aman : ‟ Ibinoŋ nigiŋko, rasoŋ goye kaak awalle ho naako *batiziyiŋko. ”

Wiktin taat Yaaya-Batist gaay gaase riyoy ta Buŋdi, ŋa ɗiytu aman : ‟ Ku taliin kar a nu waa ? Nun sa Masiɗo kaak ku eriyo. Kar gay, cokiyoŋ, ŋa asa-ak aaror ho nun meendu sa da necɗo kaak naa sorin̰ n̰ugiray. ”
« Gem kol siŋtay, kuŋ kuuk min tamba ta Ibraayim ho kuŋ kuuk karmiya Buŋ, ŋa lote kat Buŋ n̰aamiite kaawoy a ŋaate jilinte.

Min Iisa astu ɗo duniiner, gee ku Zeruzaleem ho iŋ aginduwco, ŋu bal ibine a ŋaar ko Masi. Ŋu balco girse ɗo kaawin ku nabiinnar ɗo bi kan̰ji kuuk ŋu garkiyiico ay sabit. Kar gay, wiktin ta ŋu obiig Iisa ho ŋu deeyiiga, kaaw taat nabiinna kaawtu-at astu ɗo werti.
Gee-ak balji gase yoo oorin rakki taat nec iye muutuy. Iŋ taar-at di oki, ŋu indiig Pilaat a ŋaa deen̰ji. Ŋa ooytu, ŋu dakig da.
Hiyya, min kaaw taat Kitamne kaawtu ɗo bi kan̰ji astu tak ɗo werti, ŋu paayiig min ka etor, kar ŋu un̰jiig ɗo maginer.
Kar Buŋ gay nooyiig min ɗo muuti.
Min ŋa nooyga, Iisa bayinco mena dakina ɗo gee kuuk jaaw iŋ ŋaar awalle min ɗo kiɗ ka Galile yoo ɗo geeger ka Zeruzaleem. Diŋ gay, ŋuur kon di saadinnay ɗo uŋco ka geemir
ho nin meenini iyaakonta Kabarre ta Gala : ta taar ko taat Buŋ kaawiico ɗo aginiyte min daayum,
ho diŋka, ɗo ginte kooginco, ŋa necta wiktin taat ŋa nooyit Iisa Masi min ɗo muuti. Ar taat ŋu siirtu ɗo *Soom ta seeriŋkar aman :
Buŋ gaartu pey ɗo aginiyte kadar ŋa nooyig min ɗo muuti ho ziy zooɗaaɗo keɗer. Ansii ko, Buŋ kaawtu aman :

content.text: ‟ Naako bere barkin taat nu kaawtu
taar ko kuu diye ɗo kaƴko. ”

content: Paa ko, ɗo wer ka pey, ɗo maktumne ta Soom, Dawuud kaaw aman :

content.text: ‟ Ki rasaagɗo gem kaak ki doɓtu

content: Dawuud gay, wiktin taat ŋa goyiy misa iŋ odinay, ŋa ginit riy ta Buŋdi ar taat Buŋ raktu, kar ŋa mattu. Min ŋa mattu, gee un̰jiig momtey-ak iŋ aginiyji. Hiyya, ɗo wer-ak, ŋa zooɗtu.
Kar Iisa Masi gay bal zooɗe ɗo maginer. Buŋ nooyig min ɗo muuti.

Gem kol siŋtay, ibinoŋ tam kadar iŋ siŋ ku Iisa kat ni gaariikon Kabarre ta Gala taat kaawa a Buŋ saamiykoŋ zunuubinniko. Ya ku aamin iŋ siŋji, Buŋ yaako saamiyin̰ zunuubinniko okin̰co. Saamiye ar ŋaar-aŋ, ku gasaagɗo ɗo gaanuun ka Muusa.
Diŋ gay, yaman goyoŋ goɗom ! Yampa, maan kaak nabiinna siirtu-an yaako ase ɗo kaƴko. Ŋu siir aman :

content.text: ‟ Cokiyoŋ samaane, kuŋko gee ku ɗapal.
Asaan naa gine maan kaak ajbay ɗo zamanniko.
Maan ŋaar-ak, ya ŋu osaakoŋga sa, ku aaminaajiɗo. ”

content: Wiktin taat Pool amiltu iŋ Barnabaas min ger ka salaaner-ak, gee-ak indiigu a ŋuu yeepe ƴiriy ta sabit ta asaw ŋuuco ɗeelin kaaw-ata.
Min ŋu totirtu, gee dakina kuuk *Yuudinna ho iŋ kuuk karmiyaag *gaanuun ka Muusa aaɗiig Pool iŋ Barnabaas. Ŋu kaawiico ɗo gee-ak a ŋuu obe rikimit ɗo barkin ta Buŋdi.
Min ƴiriy ta sabit astu, anuwco gee ku geegirdi n̰umtu cokiye kaaw ta Buŋdi.
Kar gay, min Yuudinna taliig gee-ak, aditco miintu iŋ hasuudinaw. Paa ko, ŋu teestu meelin̰ Pool ho ŋu wariiga.

Kar Pool iŋ Barnabaas gay kaawiico bal kolaw aman : « Loko, kuŋ Yuudinna ja kat niiko gaare kaaw ta Buŋdi, kar kuŋ gay poocta. Ampa-ak, ku gaara kadar ku bal ture gase goye ka gaasɗo. Hadi diŋ gay, ni ɓaaco iyin kaaw-an ɗo gee kuuk Yuudinnaɗo.
Taar-an gay taat Rabbin kaawinti a ni kaawe aman :

content.text: taat yaa ceere ɗo darrinay okin̰co.
Ki iyiin kaaw taat bera jile

content: Min gee kuuk Yuudinnaɗo doriit kaaw-at, ŋu aaciytu. Ŋu deliiji barkin ɗo Buŋdi ɗo bi ka kaawoy. Ho gee okin̰co kuuk Buŋ doɓtu a ŋuu gase goye ka gaasɗo, ŋuur sa aamintu iŋ Iisa Masi.
Kaaw ta Buŋdi-at totirtu ɗo kiɗ okin̰ji.
Kar Yuudinna gay, akilaag daaɗ kuuk siŋco alaw kuuk abdiyaag Buŋ ka Yuudinnar, iŋ agindaw ku geegirdi. Ŋu isiniig gee a ŋuu taaɓiyin̰ Pool iŋ Barnabaas ho ŋu atkin̰ min ɗo kiɗco.
Hiyya, Pool iŋ Barnabaas, ɗo ɗeetin̰co, ŋu kokiig burintal ku asin̰co
. Min ŋaar-ak, ŋu birtu ɗo geeger ka Ikoniyoom.
Kar *maajirna kuuk goy ɗo geeger ka Antiyoos gay, Ruwwin ta Buŋdi miiniig gelbinco ho aditco gintu portik ar buguwa.
